secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_URL
secrets.description: OmniRoute origin (https origin or /v1 endpoint, no credentials or query). Setting it makes OmniRoute the exclusive model transport for agents, media, audio and verification.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_API_KEY
secrets.description: OmniRoute inference key. Required for every model call, because OmniRoute is the configured transport. Get it from your OmniRoute deployment's API keys page.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_PROTECTION_BYPASS
secrets.description: Optional: deployment access secret, only when the OmniRoute deployment is access-protected.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_CONTROL_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: enables model-connection management (Workspace setup → Model access) against OmniRoute's internal control API.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_DASHBOARD_URL
secrets.description: Optional: browser-facing OmniRoute dashboard URL used by the 'Manage models' link; defaults to the API origin.

secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Not used while OmniRoute is configured. Only meaningful if OMNIROUTE_URL is left unset, as a direct provider key.
